newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan May 1st 10 days trade deficit 43.26 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: Japan May 1st 10 days trade deficit 43.26 bln yen.

text.p: Japan posted a customs-cleared trade deficit of 43.26 billion yen in the first 10 days of May, compared with a deficit of 254.38 billion yen in the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said on Monday.
Free-on-board (FOB) exports rose 27.5 percent from a year earlier to 998.93 billion yen, while cost, insurance and freight (CIF) imports rose 0.4 percent to 1.04 trillion yen.
